select.if: SELECT T1.CCY, T1.PRIN_AMT, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.VDATE vDate, T1.MDATE mDate, T7.TERM termDays, T7.RATE*100 yield, T7.BASIS, T6.PORTFOLIO_NAME, IFNULL(T1.P_TRADE_ID, T1.TRADE_ID) bizCode, T12.SETTLE_AMT, t14.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T14.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, t13.BUSI_ACCT_NO receiveAcctNo, T13.ACCT_NAME receiveAcctName, T13.BANK_DEP bankDep, T13.LARGE_PAYNO FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T12.IS_TOTAL_TRADE = #{NO} LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH T7 ON T7.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T6 ON T6.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T11 ON T1.COUNTER_ID = T11.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T13 ON (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T14 ON (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) WHERE (T1.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01}) OR (T1.P_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_03})

SELECT T1.CCY, T1.PRIN_AMT, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.VDATE vDate, T1.MDATE mDate, T3.TERM termDays, T5.YIELD*100 YIELD, T5.BASIS, T6.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.TRADE_ID bizCode, T12.SETTLE_AMT, t14.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T14.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, t13.BUSI_ACCT_NO receiveAcctNo, T13.ACCT_NAME receiveAcctName, T13.BANK_DEP bankDep, T13.LARGE_PAYNO FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T4.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01} AND T4.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T5 ON T4.CASH_ID = T5.CASH_ID AND T5.EFF_DATE = T3.VDATE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T6 ON T6.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T11 ON T1.COUNTER_ID = T11.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T12.IS_TOTAL_TRADE = #{NO} LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T13 ON (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) OR (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T14 ON (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) WHERE T1.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

SELECT T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.VDATE vDate, T1.MDATE mDate, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T7.TERM termDays, T7.RATE*100 yield, T7.BASIS, T7.M_TRADE_AMT, IFNULL(T1.P_TRADE_ID, T1.TRADE_ID) bizCode, T12.SETTLE_AMT, t13.BUSI_ACCT_NO receiveAcctNo, T13.ACCT_NAME receiveAcctName, T13.BANK_DEP bankDep, T14.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T14.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH T7 ON T7.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T12.IS_TOTAL_TRADE = #{NO} LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T13 ON (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) OR (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T14 ON (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) WHERE (T1.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01}) OR (T1.P_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_03})

SELECT T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.VDATE vDate, T1.MDATE mDate, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T5.BASIS, T3.M_TRADE_AMT, T3.TERM termDays, T5.YIELD*100 YIELD, T1.TRADE_ID bizCode, T12.SETTLE_AMT, t13.BUSI_ACCT_NO receiveAcctNo, T13.ACCT_NAME receiveAcctName, T13.BANK_DEP bankDep, T14.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T14.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T4.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01} AND T4.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T5 ON T4.CASH_ID = T5.CASH_ID AND T5.EFF_DATE = T3.VDATE LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T12 ON T12.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T12.IS_TOTAL_TRADE = #{NO} LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T13 ON (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) OR (T13.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T14 ON (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.MY_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_02}) OR (T14.ACCT_NO = T12.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND T12.PS = #{IE_FLAG_01}) WHERE T1.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
